steps.en: Install the skill and supply system tools and a film topic
steps.zh: 安装技能，提供系统工具与影片主题

steps.en: Fetches the shared library and reads directing and style guides
steps.zh: 获取共享库，读取导演与风格指南

steps.en: Choose a style, provide materials and decide on storyboard approval
steps.zh: 选风格、给素材，并决定是否审批分镜

steps.en: Writes and renders the film project with sound and captions
steps.zh: 编写并渲染带声音和字幕的影片工程

value.en: An editable code-drawn film and final MP4 in your project folder
value.zh: 项目目录中留下可编辑代码影片和最终 MP4
